_comment: Config for the breaker test. The device name is made up on purpose: the test must not ask for anyone's real house. The port differs from the default so the test never binds the one a real deployment listens on.
_startSettleMs: Zero, not 2000. The settle window exists so MQTT echoes from a previous life can die down; a test has no previous life, and 2 s of silence would mean every case measures the settle window rather than the behaviour. See docs/TESTING.md.
